g.text: HDMI0 only; TMDS pairs, CEC, HPD and DDC.

g.desc: HDMI0 only; TMDS pairs, CEC, HPD and DDC.

g.text: TXS0108E shifts DDC between 3.3 V and 5 V; 2.2k pull-ups on the connector side.

g.desc: TXS0108E shifts DDC between 3.3 V and 5 V; 2.2k pull-ups on the connector side.

g.text: U10 current-limits the HDMI +5V; 1 uF + 100 nF.

g.desc: U10 current-limits the HDMI +5V; 1 uF + 100 nF.

g.text: USB2514B self-powered, CFG_SEL=00, individual port power and over-current.

g.desc: USB2514B self-powered, CFG_SEL=00, individual port power and over-current.

g.text: One TPS22918 per port (500 mA port limit), one PRTR5V0U2X per port.

g.desc: One TPS22918 per port (500 mA port limit), one PRTR5V0U2X per port.

g.text: PRTPWR1-4 drive the TPS22918 ON pins; OCS_N1-4 are tied high (no over-current sensor).

g.desc: PRTPWR1-4 drive the TPS22918 ON pins; OCS_N1-4 are tied high (no over-current sensor).

g.text: Pulse JXD6-0001NL GbE magjack, 1:1. TCT/RCT to GND through 100 nF (CM4IO reference).

g.desc: Pulse JXD6-0001NL GbE magjack, 1:1. TCT/RCT to GND through 100 nF (CM4IO reference).

g.text: Four 100 ohm pairs; ESD on each pair.
